status: PROPOSED. Applied to https://bstreethq.sharepoint.com/sites/Avenue on 2026-11-11 by the developer via REST (see docs/evidence/day2-provisioning.md). Equipment, plans and table values are still awaited (Q-04, Q-22, Q-25).

groups.name: Avenue Members
groups.description: Member guest users. Read-only on catalog and calendar; add own requests only; no access to private lists.

lists.title: AvenueMyMembership
lists.description: Member-visible copy of each member's own membership. Maintained by the flow "Avenue - Membership card"; each row is shared (read) only with that member. List-level: staff and owner only.

lists.title: AvenueNoticeDrafts
lists.description: Staff-only drafts and withdrawn notices. Publishing copies a draft to AvenueNotices; withdrawing moves the notice back here, so members can no longer read it (SOP-08).

lists.title: AvenueRequiredDocTypes
lists.description: Document types every active member must hold (CMP-01). Left empty until Flavors answers Q-11; the staff Compliance screen lists members missing any active type.

lists.title: AvenueComplianceFlags
lists.description: A member says a compliance document needs staff attention. Own items only. A flow copies it to AvenueComplianceCases for staff; a second flow echoes the staff decision into Outcome (display only).

lists.title: AvenueComplianceCases
lists.description: Authoritative compliance case (private). Created by a flow from a member flag, or by staff. Status is the staff decision; Active = a booking hold, which the booking-request flow enforces (refuses new bookings).

lists.title: AvenueApplicants
lists.description: Membership applications (portal Join wizard or the public join page). Written by the integration host through the bridge flow; staff approve or reject in the Applicants screen. Members have no access.

lists.title: AvenueHostRequests
lists.description: Requests to the integration host (join payment link, payment-method portal, Stripe account link, event invoice, cancel subscription). Own items only. The flow "Avenue - Host requests" forwards each item with its author and staff check, then writes Outcome and Link back (display only).

lists.title: AvenueInvoices
lists.description: Mirror of Stripe invoices on the facility connected account (test mode). Written by the host through the bridge flow, which grants each row read to its member only (item level, like AvenueMyMembership). Staff read all.

lists.title: AvenueSensors
lists.description: Swift Sensors units and their safe ranges (docs/ENVIRONMENT_PLAN.md). Loaded from the client sheet; the owner edits ranges. Read by the integration host to classify readings. Staff only.

lists.title: AvenueSensorLatest
lists.description: Latest reading per sensor (one row each), updated in place by the integration host. Status only, never an alarm (SEN-03). Staff only.

lists.title: AvenueSensorHourly
lists.description: One summary row per sensor per completed UTC hour (min, max, average, count), written idempotently by the integration host. Compliance record (SEN-02). Staff only.

lists.title: AvenueTempExcursions
lists.description: Out-of-range episodes (opened after 2 consecutive out-of-range readings). Staff acknowledge and record the corrective action. Staff only.

lists.title: AvenueSupportMessages
lists.description: A member message to Flavors ("Messages with Flavors"). Own items only. A flow copies it to AvenueSupportCases for staff; a second flow echoes the staff reply into Reply and Outcome (display only). [PROPOSED] 23 Nov 2026, not on the live site. [PROPOSED 23 Nov 2026] Category is Text (was Choice) so topics come from AvenueSupportCategories; the live Choice->Text conversion is UNTESTED: try it on a gaptest- copy of the list first.

lists.title: AvenueEventRequests
lists.description: A member asks to book a private event (dining room). Own items only. A flow copies it to AvenueEventCases; a decision flow echoes Reply and Outcome (display only). [PROPOSED] 23 Nov 2026, not on the live site.

lists.title: AvenueStorageRequests
lists.description: A member asks to rent storage. Own items only. A flow copies it to AvenueStorageCases; staff bill by hand, nothing is created in Stripe. [PROPOSED] 23 Nov 2026, not on the live site.

lists.title: AvenueTeamMembers
lists.description: A member business's own team roster, used to prefill the team wellness check. Own items only; the roster is the member's convenience, not an access list. [PROPOSED] 23 Nov 2026, not on the live site.

lists.title: AvenueNoticeReads
lists.description: Notices the member has read, one row per notice, so read state follows them across devices. Own items only; display convenience, no flow. [PROPOSED] 23 Nov 2026, not on the live site.

lists.title: AvenueSupportCases
lists.description: Staff-side copy of member support messages, one row per conversation (ThreadId). Written by the support flows; staff set StaffReply. [PROPOSED] 23 Nov 2026, not on the live site. [PROPOSED 23 Nov 2026] Category is Text (was Choice) so topics come from AvenueSupportCategories; the live Choice->Text conversion is UNTESTED: try it on a gaptest- copy of the list first.

lists.title: AvenueEventCases
lists.description: Staff-side copy of private-event requests with the quote from the member price table. Staff approve; approval creates an EventInvoice host request. [PROPOSED] 23 Nov 2026, not on the live site.

lists.title: AvenueStorageCases
lists.description: Staff-side copy of storage requests. Staff approve or decline and enter the monthly amount; billing is by hand. [PROPOSED] 23 Nov 2026, not on the live site.

lists.title: AvenueStaffCapabilities
lists.description: What each Flavors staff e-mail may do in the staff app. The owner edits it; staff read it. The capability set is [PROPOSED] (Q-15). The staff app hides controls from it; real enforcement still needs list or flow checks. 23 Nov 2026, not on the live site.

lists.title: AvenueSupportCategories
lists.description: Topics a member can pick in "Messages with Flavors" (Title = topic name). Staff and owner edit them in Setup > Support topics; the support flow accepts only an Active title. Retire with Active = No; delete only when no case uses it. [PROPOSED] 23 Nov 2026, not on the live site.

lists.title: AvenueSupportFiles
lists.description: Private copies of attachments members add to support messages (images and PDF, at most 5 files of 10 MB each per message), written by the support flow and linked to the case by CaseId. Staff only. [PROPOSED] 23 Nov 2026, not on the live site.

lists.title: AvenueMyDocuments
lists.description: [PROPOSED] Member-visible copy of each member's registered documents (AvenueMemberDocuments). Maintained by the flow "Avenue - My documents mirror"; each row is shared (read) only with its member, like AvenueMyMembership. List-level: staff and owner only. 23 Nov 2026, not on the live site.

lists.title: AvenueMyHours
lists.description: [PROPOSED] Member-visible hours per member per facility month, summed from AvenueHoursLedger by the flow "Avenue - My hours mirror"; each row is shared (read) only with its member. List-level: staff and owner only. 23 Nov 2026, not on the live site.

lists.title: AvenueMyBookings
lists.description: [PROPOSED] Member-visible copy of bookings staff made on a member's behalf (A2: those are authored by staff, so the member cannot see the request). Maintained by the flow "Avenue - My bookings mirror"; each row is shared (read) only with its member. 23 Nov 2026, not on the live site.
